cards.headline: Bank official testifies on N500m disbursements from ONSA account to private company during Dasuki’s tenure
cards.what_happened: A bank official testified in court about N500 million in disbursements made from a Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA) account to a private company during Sambo Dasuki's tenure as National Security Adviser. The testimony concerns transfers of public funds to a private entity.
analysis: Why it matters: The testimony concerns transfers of public security funds from a government account to a private company, bearing on how public money was disbursed and to whom.
named: Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA)

cards.headline: Sunbeth completes acquisition of controlling stake in Livestock Feeds Plc
cards.what_happened: Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame Limited, a subsidiary of Sunbeth Agro HoldCo, has completed its acquisition of UAC of Nigeria Plc's 73.29% shareholding in Livestock Feeds Plc. The completion followed approvals from the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission, the Securities and Exchange Commission and Nigerian Exchange Limited.
key_facts: Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame Limited acquired UAC of Nigeria Plc's 73.29% shareholding in Livestock Feeds Plc.
Approvals came from the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission, the Securities and Exchange Commission and Nigerian Exchange Limited.
Peeyush Karnani is Chief Strategy Officer of Sunbeth Agro HoldCo.
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Premium Times; not verified with CAC records.
named: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission

cards.headline: UAC completes sale of 43% stake in DP World Logistics to TGI Group
cards.what_happened: UAC of Nigeria Plc has completed the sale of its 43% equity stake in DP World Logistics Limited, formerly MDS Logistics Limited, to 22 Plus Invest Limited, a member of Tropical General Investments (TGI) Group. The deal followed approval from the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC). UAC did not disclose the financial terms of the transaction.
key_facts: UAC of Nigeria Plc completed the sale of its 43% equity interest in DP World Logistics Limited.
The buyer is 22 Plus Invest Limited, a member of Tropical General Investments (TGI) Group.
The sale followed approval from the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC).
The divestment agreement was first announced on September 24, 2026.
analysis: Why it matters: The transfer moves a 43% stake in a Nigerian logistics company to TGI Group, changing who holds significant influence over DP World Logistics' future direction. The financial terms were not disclosed, limiting public visibility into the valuation of the stake.
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Nairametrics; not verified with CAC records.
named: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission

cards.headline: CBN, NNPC sign deal to strengthen oversight of oil revenues
cards.byline: Punch · Wed 18 Nov, 15:23 Lagos · latest of 2 reports from 2 outlets
cards.what_happened: The Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) have signed a deal aimed at strengthening oversight of oil revenues.
key_facts: CBN Governor Olayemi Cardoso and NNPCL Group CEO Bayo Ojulari signed the MoU at CBN headquarters in Abuja on Tuesday. (The Eagle Online)
The CBN is custodian of NNPCL's key operational foreign currency accounts, per Cardoso. (The Eagle Online)
timeline: Wed 18 Nov, 14:49 · The Eagle Online: “CBN, NNPCL sign MoU to strengthen oil revenue management, boost FX reserves |”
Wed 18 Nov, 15:23 · Punch: “CBN, NNPC sign deal to strengthen oversight of oil revenues” (lead report)
analysis: Why it matters: Oversight of oil revenues bears directly on how public money from the petroleum sector is tracked and accounted for in Nigeria, though the available text gives no detail on the deal's terms.

cards.headline: NRS flags trillions in potential illicit financial flows
cards.what_happened: The Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) has flagged potential illicit financial flows totalling trillions of naira.
